description: Get what Laptop Part Finder covers before you search: supported brands, every model (slug, display name, brand, and the part types it has with a fit count each), part types with part/fit/model counts, total counts, data_revision and the generated date. Use it to check whether a brand, model or part type is covered at all. Not covered means LPF has no documented fit, not that a part is incompatible. No arguments.
name: get_coverage

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Get coverage manifest
